body: The spec resolves several prior ambiguities cleanly (paired Wilcoxon replacing Mann-Whitney; pass_rate as filter rather than testability metric), but three defects remain. (1) The pass_rate filter in FR-005 breaks the pairing that justifies the Wilcoxon test in FR-004: if LLM-generated solutions failing the 0.80 threshold are dropped while their human counterparts are retained (or vice versa), the paired design is no longer intact, and the surviving sample is selected on functional correctness — precisely the property most correlated with generation quality — biasing any subsequent structural comparison. The spec should state how pairs are handled under filtering and what effective N results. (2) The spec silently inflates the sample from the idea's 'subset (n=50)' to all 164 tasks; this is defensible but should be stated as a deliberate change, since it also changes the MDES calculation in FR-008. (3) SC-001 through SC-004 are boilerplate ('Support-ticket volume for [X]', 'Mobile support is out of scope') that bears no relation to the research artifact; the placeholder '[X]' is literally unresolved. These criteria measure nothing the pipeline produces and should be replaced with criteria tied to the metrics JSON and statistical outputs.
